lines.promise-1: Promise one. Public infrastructure investment. Invest in roads, paths and public services around our sites, and fund the power and water infrastructure our sites need. ... Kept: a public bike path, and land for a future fire station, in Minooka, Illinois.
lines.promise-2: Promise two. Power responsibility. Pay our full share of grid costs, so our demand does not raise residents’ bills. ... Kept: a ten-year transmission agreement with Com Ed, that the utility described as a model.
lines.promise-3: Promise three. Jobs and skills development. Create quality jobs and educational pathways for tomorrow’s workforce. ... Kept: school partnerships through Pathways to Tech, starting in Ashburn and Dallas.
lines.promise-4: Promise four. Natural resource protection. Use water and land carefully, and report transparently. ... Kept: avoiding water-based cooling at new sites in water-stressed areas.
lines.promise-5: Promise five. Bridge the digital divide. Expand access to connectivity, skills and careers. ... Kept: twenty-eight We Are Equinix teams supported thirty-one local digital inclusion nonprofits, in twenty twenty-five.
